sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 9

items.sefariaRef: Talmud Eser HaSefirot, Section IV, List of Answers on Topics 9:1
items.html: Only a single vessel, that of Keter, was made after the departure, because the departure was all at once and in a single moment. And although we discern ten Sefirot there, this is after the likeness of a vessel whose parts are not equal. (Chapter 1, Item 10)
